text: {"claims":[{"cid":"c1","text":"A meta-analysis of 82 studies (3,574 estimates) finds a small but positive average effect of working from home on productivity.","cited_pids":["0a130e4f39dc#0"]},{"cid":"c2","text":"The positive remote work productivity effect is driven by gains in hourly productivity and more hours worked.","cited_pids":["0a130e4f39dc#0"]},{"cid":"c3","text":"A review of 50+ studies reports a median remote work productivity impact of +10% for focused tasks.","cited_pids":["d658dc380b73#5"]},{"cid":"c4","text":"A review of 50+ studies reports a median remote work productivity impact of -4% for collaborative tasks.","cited_pids":["d658dc380b73#5"]},{"cid":"c5","text":"Bloom's randomized trial at Trip.com found a hybrid schedule showed no measurable productivity difference compared with in-office peers.","cited_pids":["d658dc380b73#5"]},{"cid":"c6","text":"A study finds full-remote work (five days a week) is associated with reduced work productivity.","cited_pids":["abefd158b9c2#2"]},{"cid":"c7","text":"A study finds full-remote work (five days a week) is associated with increased presenteeism risk.","cited_pids":["abefd158b9c2#2"]},{"cid":"c8","text":"Conscientiousness predicts higher self-reported productivity when working from home.","cited_pids":["44ecc13330bd#0"]}]}
